Capex & expansion: During the year, manufacturing operations were consolidated at this integrated facility, creating a centralised production ecosystem designed to enhance operational efficiency, optimise logistics and support future capacity expansion.

Policy support has continued through the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Food Processing Industries, which, against an outlay of I10,900 crore, has attracted investment of over I9,200 crore and created additional processing capacity of approximately 35 lakh metric tonnes.
